page.notes: No marginal notes. Show-through and the edges of the neighbouring page at both margins are left out. The reading "eru-endi" and "ample-cti" are split words at line ends, joined here with their printed hyphens. The reading "Rofarum" in the Latin text is taken from the scan and may be a misprint for "Rosarum". The reading "fancientium" is slightly uncertain: the letters are clear but the scan is faint, so it is not marked [?]. The "trans-latione" split is read from the scan and the upper stroke is faint.
